3_exit_and_lifecycle.qitiao: The callback is an interval owned by each HUD wrapper. qitiao itself has no zhanting guard and does not clear its interval; pause therefore leaves sampling alive but ql normally unchanged. A valid observer must record callback occurrence and ql, not infer pause from a frozen qt frame.
3_exit_and_lifecycle.qt_child: qt.gotoAndStop changes the parent selection; it does not imply child 1763 is stopped. Entering qt301 starts/restarts the nested child timeline from its placement state; leaving qt301 removes it. No production shortcut may advance it by assigning a parent frame.
3_exit_and_lifecycle.countdown: The countdown interval is separate from qitiao and is gated inside time(); maxtime==100 or modo==4 selects the unlimited label instead of registering timeset.

countdown period is 1000 ms wall-clock interval
countdown does not decrement during zhanting, fighter sw, KO, or modo 4
qt301 child frame is an independent source timeline and must retain authored nested layers
